Good food. Good fish. Neither a hipster joint nor a tourist trap.
Aug 2023 • Couples
This unpretentious fish restaurant has excellent flavors and spends its time on GOOD FISH, not on being the coolest, sexiest restaurant on the block. It pays off. It's a good space, like a converted warehouse with lots of fresh air and a lively view of the street, very clean and open. We had an amazing meal with eel, clams, and other dishes for $17, and were full when we left. Most of the crowd was cheerful big groups of locals, always a good sign. Service was a little scattered - young kids acting like kids on their first job - but very polite and patient, as we spoke 0 Vietnamese and they spoke 5% English. Great experience!
